alternatives.option: Add a Codex manifest directly to plugin/
alternatives.reason_rejected: Shared .mcp.json and hooks configuration would couple client-specific behavior, and Codex does not consume Claude commands/agents as those components.
Duplicates sensitive launcher and lifecycle fixes, leading to release skew.

assumptions: Request is for a repository distribution equivalent to the existing Claude plugin, not only a personal installation.
macOS/Linux or WSL with Node >=22.13 and bash matches the existing launcher support boundary.
Plugin version tracks the existing Claude plugin release version.
context: Planned a generated Codex distribution of the Claude Twining plugin, preserving launcher and lifecycle behavior with focused platform adapters.
rationale: Shared sources prevent launcher, bundle, hook and workflow drift; separate package permits Codex-specific skills and patch adapters without changing Claude behavior. Reconsider if Codex gains fully compatible command and agent discovery or conversion rules become more complex than shared templates.
summary: Chose a generated self-contained plugins/twining package over a hand-maintained fork or a dual-manifest Claude directory
